summary: The agent sets up a standard LightGBM workflow with K-Fold cross-validation but introduces several critical execution and evaluation flaws. Most notably, dropping NaN rows in the test set will corrupt the submission length, and using LightGBM's early stopping callback without explicitly passing validation sets will guarantee an execution crash. Furthermore, the agent incorrectly reports the best individual fold score instead of the average, and scales the data prior to the CV split, introducing fold leakage.
